_note: Three hooks. SessionStart (session-start.sh) is the CONFIDENCE SIGNAL — on a new/resumed session it tells the model to surface a brief 'brain active, user-level, here's how to use it' confirmation so the user KNOWS it's on. UserPromptSubmit (ground-ruvnet.sh) intercepts at the INTENT level — grounding directive on rUv-stack prompts, a drift gate on classical defaults (fires even with no RuvNet mention), and a TAKE-THE-WHEEL directive on build requests (propose the architecture + why → one go/no-go → orchestrate end-to-end with SPARC/Ruflo/parallel agents/AgentDB). PreToolUse (hijack-ruvnet.sh) intercepts at the ACTION level — when Claude is about to Write/Edit/Bash a classical default it injects the rUv replacement via additionalContext WITHOUT blocking. stdout from these hooks is how the brain makes grounding + orchestration non-optional. Every script exits 0 and is guarded with `|| true` so it can never block or error a turn.
